name: humanizer-pro
description: Revise supplied drafts, analyze uncertain writing-style signals, and check existing Humanizer PRO allowance through a local CLI.

interface.longDescription: Humanizer PRO helps writers and editors revise drafts they supply and check their existing word allowance. It supports general writing, academic drafts and marketing copy. Requested analysis returns uncertain writing-style signals. Results include the service wording, word usage and advice to review facts and meaning. This writing productivity skill runs a readable bundled local CLI and requires a local terminal, Node 20.11 or later, and browser sign-in on the same computer. Rewriting sends the selected passage to Humanizer PRO and its disclosed rewriting processor, uses existing account words, and saves source and output in private service history. Requested analysis sends the selected passage to the disclosed analysis processor without using words or saving history. No purchases, upgrades, automatic recharges, background execution or automatic retries. Local OAuth tokens are stored outside the plugin with private filesystem permissions, not encryption. A remote conversation alone cannot run this local CLI. Do not supply secrets or restricted personal data.
defaultPrompt: Use Humanizer PRO to revise a passage I supply.
Check my Humanizer PRO word allowance.
